== Publication history ==
* The [[:File:V0-D-marajadewithlightsaber-2018-07-08.gif|earlier composite]] retains the original photograph.<ref name="img-marajadewithlightsab022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/marajadewithlightsaber.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/marajadewithlightsaber.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>
* The [[:File:V0-D-marajadewithlightsaber-2022-07-31.png|2022 remaster]] keeps the photograph and card text, and updates the presentation.<ref name="img-marajadewithlightsabab74419">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/marajadewithlightsaber.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/marajadewithlightsaber.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>
* The Players Committee announced replacement art for the same card in November 2025.<ref name="pc-mara-art-announcement">Star Wars CCG Players Committee, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86206#p1443014 Errata, Art, and a Set 26 Spoiler!] (15 November 2025), Mara Jade With Lightsaber art update.</ref> The [[:File:V0-D-marajadewithlightsaber.gif|December composite]] and [[:File:V0-D-marajadewithlightsaber-2025-12-26-sheet-slip.png|December printable slip]] use the new art and the same game text.<ref name="img-marajadewithlightsab22b59ba">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/marajadewithlightsaber.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/22b59ba74818e5ab47e9b65b0877fd1acbf78a1b commit 22b59ba] (8 December 2025); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/marajadewithlightsaber.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref><ref name="sheet26-20251226">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2025”; file created 26 December 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 26]] (8 December 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>
